2026_01_TB_CIN.headline: Tampa Bay’s thinner skill and tackle depth raises the cost of trading scores with Cincinnati
2026_01_TB_CIN.paragraph1: Tampa Bay lists Jalen McMillan, Sean Tucker and Justin Skule as doubtful, reducing depth at receiver, running back and tackle against a Cincinnati offense built around Joe Burrow and Ja’Marr Chase. The Buccaneers can keep the matchup balanced by protecting the passer, leaning on their healthier top targets and making the Bengals drive the field rather than surrendering explosive plays. Cincinnati’s opportunity is to accelerate the game and force Tampa Bay’s thinner offense into obvious passing situations.
2026_01_TB_CIN.model_rationale: Cincinnati can raise the game’s tempo and pressure Tampa Bay’s reduced depth, while the Buccaneers need protection and possession efficiency to avoid a shootout on unfavorable terms.
